headline: ADI posts a data-converter SoC verification role for RNM, Verilog-AMS and SystemC models
fact: Analog Devices posted a Mixed Signal Design Verification Engineer role in Wilmington for its Advanced Data-converter Group. The mandate develops analog circuit and system models for functional and connectivity verification of wireless mixed-signal SoCs and implements testbenches for product usage scenarios. It requests SystemVerilog including RNM, Verilog-AMS or SystemC modeling, scripting and circuit-verification experience, with UVM familiarity preferred. The qualifications specify an MSEE or a BSEE with at least two years of industry experience. Official JobPosting metadata identifies August 4 as datePosted for R263851.

sources.title: Analog Devices Careers: Mixed Signal Design Verification Engineer (R263851)
sources.summary: Official employer page and public job data confirm the data-converter SoC modeling mandate. JobPosting datePosted and job-data startDate both identify August 4, 2026.
